title: Electrification Could Cut Global Energy Use in Half
summary: This Fully Charged podcast episode discusses the potential for widespread electrification to substantially reduce global energy consumption. It explores the energy, technological, and policy transitions needed to achieve greater efficiency through electrification.
problem_solved: The episode addresses how the global energy system can become more efficient by replacing fossil-fuel-based energy use with electrification.
why_valuable: It provides insight into a major strategy for reducing energy consumption, emissions, and dependence on fossil fuels through technological and societal change.
